provenance: WPA Tournament Table & Equipment Specifications sec 8 (table speed): a firm center-ball lag from the head spot travels 4-4.5 table lengths of total path. The WPA specifies the DISTANCE window, not a stroke speed; cue_v0 is the kernel's documented reference calibration point for that window (tune jointly with u_r/e_c if recalibrated - docs/research/gap-k66-cushion-params.md sec 5/6).
